subject: Post-demo: Guardian Health stakeholder map + PO/onboarding next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@guardianhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Guardian Health stakeholder map + PO/onboarding next steps

Hi Sara — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment with your procurement and security teams.

Summary from today:
- Attendees: Sara Jenkins (Dir, PM), Michael Hayes (Procurement lead, joined last 15m), Dr. Elena Park (Clinical stakeholder), and Vivek + Lauren from Redwood.
- Primary use case: embedding search + clinical note summarization for post-visit workflows (PII limited).
- Main decision criteria: latency (sub-200ms 95th for short queries), SOC 2 + data handling assurances, predictable unit costs, and SSO + audit logs.

Open asks we surfaced: 
1) Economic buyer / approver: who signs the PO? (Sara, can you confirm job title / name?)
2) Procurement intake process: required forms, PO template, and invoice routing (email or AP portal)
3) Security evidence: are the vendor intake questionnaire and SOC2 summary sufficient, or do you need on-site audits / pen-test reports?
4) Timeline constraint: you mentioned a Q4 rollout window — can you confirm target procurement cutover date?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Sara to confirm procurement contact and PO routing (who receives invoices and invoice cadence).
- Lauren: I asked her to prepare a 1-page SOC2 summary + brief on data segregation for your review (will send by EOD Mon).
- Rishi: will draft a scoped SOW and initial billing model to align with your expected volume; I attached an early draft for context.
- Schedule a 30-min procurement & security sync with your procurement lead and security engineer. I propose Tue Aug 24 or Wed Aug 25 morning PST.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, scoped-sow-draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll wait for procurement contact and preferred day/time.

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM serving for predictable latency and costs

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Guardian Health stakeholder map + PO/onboarding next steps

Hi Vivek — great summary, thank you. Quick answers below and a couple of attachments from our side.

Economics / approver:
- Economic approver: CFO (Mark Delaney) signs >$50k ARR; for pilots <$50k, I can approve.

Procurement path / contacts:
- Procurement lead: Michael Hayes (mike.hayes@guardianhealth.com) — added him on this thread.
- AP/invoicing: ap@guardianhealth.com (electronic invoices via Coupa preferred but we accept emailed invoices).
- Our standard vendor intake: I attached the vendor-intake-form.xlsx — completion required before PO issuance.

Security / compliance:
- SOC2 Type II report acceptable; we also require SSRA (third-party risk) answers and an encryption summary.

Timeline:
- Target: pilot purchase order in 6–8 weeks (aiming for Sept 30 cutover for pilot data ingestion).

Michael, can you confirm any additional steps on your side for vendor setup?

Sara Jenkins
Director, Product Management — Clinical Tools
Sara.Jenkins@guardianhealth.com

Attachments: vendor-intake-form.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Guardian Health stakeholder map + PO/onboarding next steps

Thanks Sara — really helpful. Michael — great to meet you via email. A few quick notes and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we hit your Sept 30 goal: 

1) Docs I’ll upload to your portal / email:
   - Completed vendor intake (we’ll fill the spreadsheet and return by Thu Aug 26)
   - W-9 / company billing information (attaching W-9 stub; will send signed copy)
   - SOC2 summary + encryption note (Lauren will send by end of day Mon Aug 24)

2) Redwood asks / dependencies:
   - Access for pilot data ingestion: SFTP or temporary cloud bucket with scoped credentials (we prefer ephemeral keys).
   - IP/Network allowlist: will provide the IP ranges once we finalize model selection.

3) Proposed MAP and timings:
   - Thu Aug 26: Redwood returns completed vendor intake and W-9.
   - Mon Aug 30: Security sync (30m) to review SOC2 summary and SSRA items.
   - Fri Sep 10: Draft PO and SOW exchanged for review.
   - Week of Sep 20: Target PO signed and procurement onboarding complete.

Links: Mutual action plan draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDemoMUTUAL-ACTION-PLAN
DocuSign NDA (optional, can be signed early): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/0a1b-guardian-nda

Lauren / Rishi — can you confirm the SOC2 one-pager and the SOW draft timeline? I’ll also prepare an invoice template matching Guardian’s Coupa fields and send to ap@guardianhealth.com.

On Thu Aug 26 we’ll return the intake spreadsheet and W-9 — if Michael can confirm whether we should upload to a vendor portal or send via email that day, we’ll follow your preference.

Best,
Vivek

Vivek / Sara — thanks for looping me in. Quick logistics from procurement side: 

- Vendor setup: please email completed vendor-intake-form.xlsx and a W-9 to procurement@guardianhealth.com. We will confirm vendor code within 3–5 business days of receipt.
- Contracts: our legal requires a redline-able SOW (Word doc) + standard PO terms; no stand-alone NDAs are required for commercial pilots under $50k (Sara correct me if I’m wrong).
- Invoicing: send invoices to ap@guardianhealth.com and include our vendor code on the invoice once assigned. We pay net 45 by default.

I’ll put a tentative vendor onboarding hold on Sept 1 to prioritize this if we get the intake materials by Aug 26.

Mike Hayes
